decision_conditions: The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall be as agreed by the Local Planning Authority.
The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

<div>Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no windows / doors, other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevations of the</div><div>development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.&nbsp;</div>
The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of the original permission (21-01-2025).

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;</p><p>0010/revP04, 0101/revP04, 0102/revP04, 0201/revP04, 0301/revP04, 0302/revP04, 0303/revP04, 0304/revP04, 0401/revP04, 0402/revP04, Heritage Statement (miguel rodrigues - 27/08/2024), Detail of A/C Unit Enclosure, Noise Impact Assessment - 19643-NIA-02 RevB Clement Acoustics (03/12/2024), Reasonable Exception Statement and new plans received by the Local Planning Authority on <b>29-07-2025</b> - 1101/revP08, 1102/revP09, 1201/revP07, 1301/revP09, 1302/revP08, 1303/revP08, 1304/revP07, 1401/revP06, 1402/revP07.&nbsp;</p>
